sentences.en: Over the years, Kitty Genovese's murder has been the focus of countless books,

sentences.en: but because it supposedly explained a deep flaw in human nature.

sentences.en: The New York Times published an article that said dozens of people saw the murder

sentences.en: In the decades that followed, the case came to symbolize a psychological phenomenon
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，这起案件成为了心理学现象的象征，

sentences.en: known as the bystander effect.
sentences.zh: 即所谓的“旁观者效应”。

sentences.en: When lots of people see something is wrong, the theory goes,
sentences.zh: 该理论认为，当许多人看到有事情不对劲时，

sentences.en: each person wrongly assumes someone else will step up to help.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会错误地认为别人会站出来帮忙。

sentences.en: The net effect is that as the number of potential helpers increases,
sentences.zh: 最终的结果是，随着潜在援助者人数的增加，

sentences.en: the number of people who actually help decreases.

sentences.en: In recent years, psychologists and journalists have re-examined the facts of the Kitty Genovese story
